C1.for_what_part: Only the staged set is compared with the approved list, for missing and extra customers. Neither instrument reads the live tables, so the live result is tied to the staged set only through the promotion's line in the record.

C2.for_what_part: Row counts, the full set of customers, and the number of accounts holding the fixed value, all measured on the staged set. The live tables are not read.

C4.for_what_part: No unnamed table or column is touched, and no more rows than the agreement names, all on the staged set. Deletions are covered. The live tables are not read.

C7.for_what_part: Reversibility on a copy of the live tables at the time it is taken. It does not show that the worker kept the undo material after tidying. That also rests on the record.

C8.for_what_part: The recipients and wording match those promoted and the approved wording, and the count to send. It does not show that notices were actually ordered.

C9.for_what_part: Confirmed and unconfirmed sending calls, with recipient and wording fingerprints against the release, as of the time taken. Calls ordered after that time are outside it.

plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: For C3, an instrument that applies the requester's category rule to each account. For C5, a plan-level scope check on the worker's reads. For C10, a plan-level trace of the sending calls against the outbox. Scope of a call and trace of a call can only be asked for on named lines during the work, and trace only from A3. An instrument reading the live tables after the promotion would also have helped for C1, C2 and C4.
